candidate.definition_en: In the period after a specified time in the past.
candidate.explanation_ar: من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمر لحد دلوقتي.

senses.definition_en: From a particular time or event in the past until now or until another time in the past.
senses.definition_ar: منذ / من وقت معين في الماضي وحتى الآن

examples: I have been here since Monday.
She has known him since childhood.
It has been raining since this morning.
